description: Runs a Google PageSpeed Insights audit of a public website on mobile: performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores, Core Web Vitals, the issues that weigh most, missing security headers and page weight. Takes 20 to 90 seconds. Only public http(s) addresses.

locale.description: Answer language: English (en) or European Portuguese (pt).

url.description: Public website address, e.g. example.pt or https://www.example.com/page.

name: run_website_audit
title: Website audit (PageSpeed, mobile)
